check.ai_crawlers_allowed.label: AI crawler access
check.ai_crawlers_allowed.OK: AI search crawlers (ChatGPT search, Claude, Perplexity) are allowed in robots.txt.
check.ai_crawlers_allowed.WARN: Some AI search crawlers are not clearly allowed in robots.txt.
check.ai_crawlers_allowed.BAD: AI search crawlers are not allowed in robots.txt, so AI search will not read this site.
check.edge_access.label: CDN and edge access
check.edge_access.OK: Your CDN or WAF is letting AI bots through.
check.edge_access.WARN: Something at the edge may be slowing AI bots down.
check.edge_access.BAD: AI bots are being blocked before they reach your site.
check.edge_access.UNKNOWN: We could not check edge access this time (no response in time). It does not count against your score.
check.server_rendered_html.label: Server-rendered HTML
check.server_rendered_html.OK: Your content and schema are in the raw HTML.
check.server_rendered_html.WARN: Only part of your content is in the raw HTML.
check.server_rendered_html.BAD: The raw HTML carries neither your content nor your schema, so crawlers that skip JavaScript see an empty page.
check.schema.label: Structured data
check.schema.OK: Valid JSON-LD with the right type and the key properties filled in.
check.schema.WARN: Your JSON-LD is missing some of the properties AI looks for.
check.schema.BAD: No usable JSON-LD was found in the raw HTML.
check.coverage.label: Key information coverage
check.coverage.OK: Name, address, phone, hours, location and URL are all published.
check.coverage.WARN: Some of your name, address, phone, hours, location or URL is missing.
check.coverage.BAD: The basics AI needs - name, address, phone, hours, location, URL - are mostly missing.
check.legibility.label: Readable page text
check.legibility.OK: Your key facts, headings and FAQ are readable in the page text.
check.legibility.WARN: Your key facts are hard to find in the page text.
check.legibility.BAD: The page text does not state your key facts, so AI has only your markup to go on.
check.llms.label: llms.txt
check.llms.OK: llms.txt is published and describes this site.
check.llms.WARN: llms.txt is published but thin on detail.
check.consistency.label: Consistency and freshness
check.consistency.OK: Your schema agrees with your page text and carries a freshness signal.
check.consistency.WARN: Your schema and page text disagree in places, or the freshness signal is missing.
check.consistency.BAD: Your schema contradicts your page text, which makes AI distrust both.
field.label.name: Name
field.label.headline: Headline
field.label.author: Author
field.meaning.name: Official name.
field.meaning.geo: Latitude and longitude of the location.
field.meaning.sameAs: Official social or profile URLs identifying the same business.
field.meaning.image: URL of an image depicting the product or article.
field.meaning.description: Description of the product or service.
field.meaning.offers.price: Sale or service price (0 for free).
field.meaning.offers.priceCurrency: Currency code for the price, such as JPY.
field.meaning.offers.availability: Stock or sale status, such as InStock.
field.meaning.aggregateRating: Rating and count based on real reviews.
field.meaning.headline: Title of the article.
field.meaning.author: Person or organization that wrote the article.
field.meaning.datePublished: Date and time the article was published.
field.meaning.dateModified: Date and time of the last article update.
field.about: Published data that tells AI the {label}.
field.howto.business: Set this in Nurevo → Business information and publish it on the relevant page.
field.howto.reviews: Output aggregateRating values and counts from real published reviews.
field.howto.services: Set this in Nurevo → Services and the service page.
field.howto.article: Publish this in WordPress → Edit post and your SEO plugin settings.
field.howto.faq: Add questions and answers in Nurevo → FAQ.
field.textHint: State the name and description in page text; add headings and FAQ.
field.unsupported: Nurevo has no dedicated input for this field. Publish the real information using a compatible SEO plugin’s structured data settings.
field.publish: Set {field} to the actual information on the public page using a compatible SEO plugin’s structured data settings.
field.software.location: Edit the LP JSON-LD template or a plugin that supports SoftwareApplication. Nurevo has no dedicated input for this field.
field.instruction.name: Publish the official name on the page and use the same name in structured data.
field.instruction.image: Set a public image URL in the product image or article featured image settings.
field.instruction.description: Describe what you provide, who it serves and the problem it solves on the page; use that text for description.
field.instruction.brand: Set the actual brand in product brand settings. If unavailable, configure Product.brand in a compatible SEO plugin.
field.instruction.sku: In WooCommerce → Edit product → Product data → Inventory, set the SKU.
field.instruction.offers.price: Set offers.price to a number matching the published price; use 0 for a free plan.
field.instruction.offers.priceCurrency: Set offers.priceCurrency to the published price’s ISO 4217 currency code, such as JPY or USD.
field.instruction.offers.availability: Set actual stock status in inventory settings and output a schema.org URL such as InStock in offers.availability.
field.instruction.aggregateRating: Aggregate only real published reviews into aggregateRating.ratingValue and ratingCount or reviewCount. Do not invent ratings when there are no reviews.
field.instruction.applicationCategory: Set SoftwareApplication.applicationCategory to a category matching the app’s purpose, such as BusinessApplication.
field.instruction.operatingSystem: Set SoftwareApplication.operatingSystem to the supported OS or runtime, such as Web or WordPress.
